darpan.rule.RuleSet.description: Every exchange or warranty credit memo against the replacement order that names it: one customer, and not the return's own original order.

darpan.rule.RuleSetCompareScope.description: Every exchange or warranty credit memo against the replacement order that names it: one customer, and not the return's own original order.

darpan.rule.Rule.ruleLogic: rule "GORJANA_MR_SAME_CUSTOMER" when $m : Map(this["file1"] != null, this["file2"] != null) eval(!java.util.Objects.equals(((Map) $m.get("file1")).get("customerId"), ((Map) $m.get("file2")).get("customerId"))) then Object _file1Value = ((Map) $m.get("file1")).get("customerId"); Object _file2Value = ((Map) $m.get("file2")).get("customerId"); reconciliation.rule.RuleDiffSupport.addFieldMismatch( $m, kcontext.getRule().getName(), "customerId = customerId", _file1Value, _file2Value, "WARN", "Field comparison failed: customerId = customerId" ); end

rule "GORJANA_MR_NOT_OWN_ORIGINAL" when $m : Map(this["file1"] != null, this["file2"] != null) eval(java.util.Objects.equals(((Map) $m.get("file1")).get("orderId"), ((Map) $m.get("file2")).get("orderId"))) then Object _file1Value = ((Map) $m.get("file1")).get("orderId"); Object _file2Value = ((Map) $m.get("file2")).get("orderId"); reconciliation.rule.RuleDiffSupport.addFieldMismatch( $m, kcontext.getRule().getName(), "orderId != orderId", _file1Value, _file2Value, "WARN", "Field comparison failed: orderId != orderId" ); end

rule "GORJANA_MR_NOT_YEAR_OLDER" when $m : Map(this["file1"] != null, this["file2"] != null) eval(reconciliation.rule.RuleDiffSupport.violatesOperator(reconciliation.rule.RuleDiffSupport.applyPreActions(((Map) $m.get("file1")).get("yearBeforeDay"), java.util.Arrays.asList("STRING_TO_INT")), reconciliation.rule.RuleDiffSupport.applyPreActions(((Map) $m.get("file2")).get("dayNumber"), java.util.Arrays.asList("STRING_TO_INT")), "<=")) then Object _file1Value = reconciliation.rule.RuleDiffSupport.applyPreActions(((Map) $m.get("file1")).get("yearBeforeDay"), java.util.Arrays.asList("STRING_TO_INT")); Object _file2Value = reconciliation.rule.RuleDiffSupport.applyPreActions(((Map) $m.get("file2")).get("dayNumber"), java.util.Arrays.asList("STRING_TO_INT")); reconciliation.rule.RuleDiffSupport.addFieldMismatch( $m, kcontext.getRule().getName(), "yearBeforeDay <= dayNumber", _file1Value, _file2Value, "WARN", "Field comparison failed: yearBeforeDay <= dayNumber" ); end

darpan.audit.AuditCheck.label: Exchange credit memos whose replacement order is under another customer
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.matchedBy: credit memo id (custbody_hc_exchange_credit_memo_id on the replacement order)
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.headlineTemplate: Credit memo id {creditMemo} and its replacement order are under different customers
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.fixActionTemplate: Move the credit memo with internal id {creditMemo} to its replacement order's customer (the store's own customer when the shopper gave none).
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.passesWhenTemplate: The credit memo with internal id {creditMemo} and its replacement order have the same customer.

darpan.audit.AuditCheck.label: Exchange credit memos whose replacement is an existing order (its own original, or a year older)
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.matchedBy: credit memo id (custbody_hc_exchange_credit_memo_id on the replacement order)
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.headlineTemplate: Credit memo id {creditMemo} names an existing order as its replacement
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.fixActionTemplate: Unlink the credit memo with internal id {creditMemo} from the original order and apply it to the return's own replacement order.
darpan.audit.AuditCheck.passesWhenTemplate: The replacement of the credit memo with internal id {creditMemo} is a new order, not the one the return came from.
